text: The first block starts with five specified 32-bit initial words. Each later block starts from the preceding block result.
notes: Semantic relationship to observed digests. Per-test RTL coverage is unavailable.

text: The first sixteen schedule words come from the block. Each subsequent word rotates the XOR of four earlier words left by one bit.
notes: Semantic relationship to observed digests. Per-test RTL coverage is unavailable.

text: Each group of twenty rounds selects a Boolean function and a constant. Each round combines the rotated working word, function, constant, schedule word and fifth working word modulo 2^32.
notes: Semantic relationship to observed digests. Per-test RTL coverage is unavailable.

text: After eighty rounds, combine each working word with its corresponding incoming hash word modulo 2^32. Concatenating the five words in order produces the digest.
notes: Semantic relationship to observed digests. Per-test RTL coverage is unavailable.
